name: mainmenu
author: Weblytic Labs
description: Build and manage your storefront’s main navigation. Add categories, CMS pages, and custom links, set order and visibility, and open selected links in a new tab.
setup_steps: Open Main menu → Configure and add the items you want in the header.
Use Main menu → Links for custom URLs (labels, destination, new tab).
In Theme settings → Header, choose Custom menu (Main menu) so the storefront uses this menu.
Save and refresh the storefront to see your navigation.
